A '''human''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was taken into [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and was the door greeter of the [[Nexus Room]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. In [[3950 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] was present as the door greeter of the Nexus Room on Dromund Kaas when [[Meetra Surik]] came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in search of her former mentor [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The human appeared within [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
